cadastro.sub: Choose the registration type. Completing the form creates your profile panel.
cadastro.paraHacendado: Rural producer, company, or anyone hiring drone services.
cadastro.alcanceHacendado: Contractor file. Stays on the chosen plan. Stops being Visitante-BETA.
cadastro.alcancePiloto: Pilot file. Flight hours and in-training or advanced badge.
cadastro.alcanceAuxiliar: Field assistant file. Listed according to the plan.
cadastro.alcanceManutencao: Maintenance file. Publishing follows the plan.
cadastro.paraConserto: Bench, workshop or drone repair technician.
cadastro.alcanceConserto: Repair file. Publishing follows the plan.
cadastro.paraProfissional: Related trades and training who are not pilots or technicians.
cadastro.alcanceProfissional: Professional file. Enters the directory according to the plan.
